title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Thermometer
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Thermometer. A class to describe a sensor that measures temperature. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. SAREF4AGRI defines two specializations of saref:Temperature relevant to this sensor (skos:broader, ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.2.6, Figure 3): s4agri:AirTemperature and s4agri:SoilTemperature.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Thermometer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

observes.description: Property/Relationship. saref:observes. Which of the two s4agri:Property named individuals (both skos:broader of saref:Temperature) this thermometer measures: s4agri:AirTemperature ('the degree or intensity of heat present in the air') or s4agri:SoilTemperature ('the degree or intensity of heat present in the soil').

hasFeatureOfInterest.description: Relationship. saref:hasFeatureOfInterest. The entity (e.g. an Animal, a Soil, a Parcel) this temperature measurement is about.

value.description: Property. saref:hasValue. The last temperature measurement reported by the sensor.

unitCode.description: Property. saref:isMeasuredIn. The unit of measure for 'value' (e.g. 'CEL' degree Celsius).

dateObserved.description: Property. The date and time this measurement was made.

isSubSystemOf.description: Relationship. ssn:hasSubSystem (inverse). The System (e.g. a WeatherStation) this sensor is a component/subsystem of, if any.
